page.overview:
Who is Cinnabar?

Cinnabar was a female fathier that mated with the male fathier Crimson Pavane, resulting in the birth of the fathier Vermilion Vermilion had participated in a fathier race in the city Canto Bight on the casino planet Cantonica. Prior to the race, a racing guide that listed Cinnabar as Vermilion's dam was distributed; a copy of which was later collected by the Resistance mechanic Rose Tico and added to her diary while she was on a mission to Canto Bight in 34 ABY.

Cinnabar was mentioned in the 2018 replica journal The Last Jedi: Rose Tico: Resistance Fighter, written by Jason Fry.
